av2.what: AV2 is on: xrdp sends it to the clients that offer it (the kit's FreeRDP clients and FreeRDP Web), AV1 to the others. To put AV1 first again
av2.command: sudo sed -i 's/^order = \[ "AV2", "AV1"/order = [ "AV1"/' /etc/xrdp/gfx.toml && sudo systemctl restart xrdp

windows.command: Invoke-WebRequest https://github.com/congzhangzh/rdp-release-kit/releases/download/20261106.11/freerdp-host-20261106.10-windows-x86_64.zip -OutFile freerdp-host.zip; Expand-Archive freerdp-host.zip; Set-Location freerdp-host\freerdp-host-*; .\freerdp-shadow-service.exe install --allow-sas -- /bind-address:127.0.0.1 /gfx-av1 /gfx-av2 -gfx-avc444

mac.command: curl -LO https://github.com/congzhangzh/rdp-release-kit/releases/download/20261106.11/freerdp-host-20261106.10-macos-arm64.zip && ditto -x -k freerdp-host-20261106.10-macos-arm64.zip . && cd freerdp-host-20261106.10-macos-arm64 && cp -R FreeRDP-Shadow.app /Applications/ && xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/FreeRDP-Shadow.app && cp org.freerdp.shadow.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/org.freerdp.shadow.plist
mac.then: Then allow FreeRDP Shadow in System Settings > Privacy & Security, under Screen Recording and Accessibility, and run: launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/org.freerdp.shadow

linux.command: curl -LO https://github.com/congzhangzh/rdp-release-kit/releases/download/20261106.11/freerdp-host-20261106.10-linux-x86_64.tar.xz && tar -xJf freerdp-host-20261106.10-linux-x86_64.tar.xz && mkdir -p ~/.local/opt ~/.config/systemd/user && rm -rf ~/.local/opt/freerdp-host && mv freerdp-host-20261106.10-linux-x86_64 ~/.local/opt/freerdp-host && cp ~/.local/opt/freerdp-host/freerdp-shadow.service ~/.config/systemd/user/ && systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now freerdp-shadow.service
linux.then: It listens on 127.0.0.1 only: keep it there and reach it over SSH (ssh -L 13389:127.0.0.1:3389 user@server, then a client to 127.0.0.1:13389). The login is the desktop owner's own account. A desktop that does not start graphical-session.target (Xfce, MATE) starts it from its autostart: systemctl --user import-environment DISPLAY XAUTHORITY && systemctl --user start freerdp-shadow. After GNOME's Stop sharing, or to apply a change, run: systemctl --user restart freerdp-shadow
